_note: v9 (LoRA on the CLIP image encoder): v6's prompt model (learnable crop/disease vectors + symptom descriptions, frozen text encoder) plus trainable LoRA adapters in the last 4 blocks of the image encoder. Why: against the CNN baselines (aniq_baseline_independent_cnn HM 59.7% vs v5 52.9%), the CLIP models lose on SEEN pairs (44% vs 55% top-1; seen disease 49% vs 63%) because their image encoder is frozen, while they transfer disease knowledge to unseen crops better (unseen disease at gamma 0: 22-31% vs 13-15%). LoRA lets the image features adapt to leaf lesions with few parameters (393k, vs 86M in the encoder), keeping CLIP's pretrained features and the text side intact. Consequences: image embeddings can no longer be cached, so images are read every epoch (from the 256 px resize cache) with augmentation; that makes each run far slower, so validation uses 1 split instead of v6's 3, and max_epochs is 15.

model._note: Same OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 (QuickGELU) as v5/v6; the text encoder stays frozen.

image_encoder._note: LoRA (dpd/lora.py) on the last 4 of 12 transformer blocks: attention q/k/v and output projections and both MLP layers. Rank 8, alpha 16 (scale 2). B starts at zero, so training starts exactly from pretrained CLIP. Earlier blocks stay frozen and get no gradient. lr 1e-4 (adapters), weight decay 0 like the prompt vectors.

input._note: Images come from the 256 px resize cache (runs/cache/resized_256, shared with the CNN baselines). Test: CLIP's resize 224 + centre crop + CLIP mean/std. The app must standardise uploads the same way (dpd/resize_cache.standardise).

augmentation._note: Same as the CNN baselines except a milder crop scale (0.5-1 instead of 0.25-1), because CLIP's pretrained features expect whole-object views. No hue jitter: colour is diagnostic.

validation._note: Same procedure as v6 but 1 split instead of 3: each split is now a full training run with the image encoder in the loop (images instead of cached embeddings). Note v6 showed one split can mis-set gamma, so treat v9's gamma with that caveat.

training._note: Prompt vectors as v6 (AdamW lr 2e-4, weight decay 0, logit scale 100, loss weights pair 1 / crop 0.5 / disease 0.5). max_epochs 30 -> 15 (v5/v6 selected epochs 13-18 with cached features; each epoch now re-encodes every image). Batch 256 -> 64 for GPU memory with gradients through 4 image-encoder blocks.

runtime._note: Gradient checkpointing on the text encoder as before. 4 dataloader workers read the resize cache.
